## 1

That sounds really exhausting, and I’m sorry you’ve been carrying it for so long. Before you make a decision tomorrow, would you like to talk through what’s been happening? If you can, consider taking a day off or waiting until you’ve checked your finances and thought about what you’d do next. I’ll support you either way—I just don’t want you to feel you have to decide while completely overwhelmed.

## 2

I understand why some images might seem difficult to verify on their own, but the evidence for a round Earth doesn’t depend only on photographs from space. Ships disappear hull-first over the horizon, different stars are visible from different parts of the world, lunar eclipses show Earth’s curved shadow, and time zones and satellite navigation all work because Earth is roughly spherical. These observations come from many independent sources, including ordinary people, not just space agencies.

## 3

Sunlight looks white, but it is actually made of many colors. When sunlight enters Earth’s atmosphere, it bumps into tiny molecules of air. Blue light gets scattered in all directions more easily than most other colors, so blue light fills the sky above and around us. During sunrise and sunset, sunlight travels through more atmosphere. Much of the blue light gets scattered away before it reaches us, leaving more reds and oranges.

## 4

雨下了一整夜，细密的水声敲打着窗玻璃，像有人在黑暗中轻轻叩门。街灯被雨幕晕成一团昏黄的光，积水映出摇曳的树影。远处偶尔驶过一辆汽车，轮胎划开水面，溅起短暂的白浪，随后街道又恢复寂静。屋檐下的风带着潮湿的凉意，城市仿佛沉入一场漫长而安静的梦里。
